_comment: Edit this file, run `node generate.js`, get every variant in every size. The `safe` values are Meta's 2026 safe zones — read README.md before changing them.

sizes.name: 4x5-feed
sizes._use: Facebook and Instagram Feed, single image. Meta's recommended image ratio.
sizes._safeSource: No UI covers a Feed image, but Advantage+ re-crops top and bottom equally across placements. 250px top/bottom, 100px sides.
sizes._logo: Off. In Feed your Page name and avatar already sit directly above the creative, so a logo inside the image is a duplicate that costs the product 150px.

sizes.name: 1x1-carousel
sizes._use: Carousel cards, Marketplace, Right Column, Messenger. Carousel cards MUST be 1:1 — Meta crops 4:5 cards and cuts off the top and bottom.
sizes._safeSource: Instagram applies a slight crop even to correctly sized squares. Keep key elements inside a centred 1000x1000.

sizes.name: 9x16-reels
sizes._use: Reels and Stories. Built to the Reels margin, the stricter of the two, so one asset is safe on both.
sizes._safeSource: Top 14% (270px) profile name and timestamp. Bottom 35% (670px) on Reels for the like/comment/share stack, audio label and caption — Stories needs only 20% (380px), so designing to 670 covers both. Sides 6% (65px), widened to 90px for Smart Zoom on 20:9 devices.
sizes._logo: On. Reels shows the account name small and low-contrast over the video, so the logo earns its place here.
